post.description:
Generate a meal plan, verify its nutrition, and price a shopping list.

Provider credentials are server-managed only: the former X-Gemini-Api-Key
pass-through was removed in G4.

Args:
    request: The craving, dietary constraints, and optional biometrics.
    container: The application's dependency container.
    principal: The authenticated client; its client_id namespaces history.

Returns:
    The assembled meal plan response. It is persisted to history unless
    ``plan_status`` is ``infeasible``, which has no meal to keep.

401.description: A valid X-API-Key header is required.

403.description: This API key is not allowed to perform this operation.

429.description: Too many requests. Retry after the time in the Retry-After header.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until this client may retry.

503.description: Meal retrieval is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.

get.description:
List stored meal plans for one user, most recent first.

Only the caller's own namespace is searched, so a guessed ``user_id`` can
never reach another client's records.

Args:
    user_id: The user whose meal-plan history to fetch.
    container: The application's dependency container.
    principal: The authenticated client whose namespace is read.
    limit: Requested page size, clamped to the range [1, 50].

Returns:
    The clamped limit and the matching stored meal-plan records.

post.description:
Persist like/rating/save feedback for a previously generated meal.

The referenced ``request_id`` must belong to a plan in the caller's own
namespace, so one client cannot attach feedback to another client's meal.

Args:
    request: The feedback signal(s) for one meal.
    container: The application's dependency container.
    principal: The authenticated client whose namespace is written.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 400 if none of liked, rating, or saved is provided.
    MealPlanNotFound: 404 if the caller has no plan with that request_id.

Returns:
    The persisted feedback record.

DetailResponse.description: FastAPI's own error body, used by the few routes that raise HTTPException.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description:
The body of every domain error (``core/exceptions.py``).

``code`` is a stable machine-readable code, sent only by errors that have
one. ``detail`` is the client-safe message; the internal one is never sent.

MealAgentMetadata.title: MealAgentMetadata
MealAgentMetadata.description: Meal-agent metadata, which may carry an LLM-generated explanation.

MealNutrition.title: MealNutrition
MealNutrition.description:
Verified macros for one meal.

``nutrition_status`` is ``verified`` when no ingredient is estimated and
``mixed`` when at least one is. The contract's third value,
``unverified_required``, is never serialised here: it is the failing case,
returned as a NutritionProviderError with that code. ``sources`` lists the
data sources actually used.

MealPlanListResponse.title: MealPlanListResponse
MealPlanListResponse.description: Stored meal plans for one user.

MealPlanResponse.title: MealPlanResponse
MealPlanResponse.description:
A generated meal plan with its verification and reconciliation metadata.

``plan_status`` is ``matched``, ``fallback`` or ``infeasible``. On
``infeasible`` the request still succeeds: the meal-dependent sections are
null and ``infeasible_reason`` explains why, in client-safe terms.

ReconciliationMetadata.title: ReconciliationMetadata
ReconciliationMetadata.description: Records how the portion estimate compared with verified nutrition.
